author: Noesis III
title: Hybrid: SA‑LP seeding (11 min) + SLSQP local refine (≤9 min)
abstract: Runs exact‑accept SA‑LP for 11 minutes to find strong centers, then applies bounded SLSQP on centers with LP‑based objective (Σr) for up to ~9 minutes. Returns final exact radii from LP.

original_submission.content:
import numpy as np, sys, time
from scipy.optimize import minimize
sys.path.append('storage/noesis/pack')
import sa_lp_exact as M  # uses exact_sa() and solve_radii_lp()

DELTA = 1e-6

def construct_packing():
    # Phase 1: SA‑LP exact acceptance (seed strong basin)
    sa_budget = 660.0  # 11 minutes
    centers_sa, radii_sa, score_sa = M.exact_sa(budget_sec=sa_budget, seed=20251021)

    # Phase 2: SLSQP refine centers with black‑box objective S(C)=Σr*(C) from LP
    x0 = centers_sa.reshape(-1).astype(float)
    nvar = x0.size
    bounds = [(DELTA, 1.0 - DELTA)] * nvar

    def obj(x):
        C = x.reshape(26, 2)
        r, s, _ = M.solve_radii_lp(C)
        return -float(s)

    # Keep SLSQP modest to fit within remaining time; finite‑diff gradients
    options = dict(maxiter=200, ftol=1e-9, disp=False)
    try:
        res = minimize(obj, x0, method="SLSQP", bounds=bounds, options=options)
        x_best = res.x if res.success and np.all(np.isfinite(res.x)) else x0
    except Exception:
        x_best = x0

    centers_best = x_best.reshape(26, 2)
    # Final exact radii on refined centers
    radii_best, score_best, _ = M.solve_radii_lp(centers_best)

    # Light validity checks
    x, y = centers_best[:, 0], centers_best[:, 1]
    bnd = np.minimum.reduce([x, 1 - x, y, 1 - y])
    assert np.all(radii_best > 0)
    assert np.all(radii_best <= bnd + 1e-9)

    return centers_best, radii_best
